params.label: Matomo token_auth (required for server-side IP / original timestamp)
params.description: Only stored server-side. Needed for cip (real device IP) and cdt (original event timestamp on queued events).

params.label: Consent Mode
params.description: How user consent (Shopgate Consent Manager) gates tracking.

options.label: Track with consent for marketing (uses statistics consent)

params.label: Cookieless fallback when consent is missing
params.description: If enabled, events are still sent without a persistent visitor id (no cookie, anonymized) when statistics/marketing consent is not given. If disabled, nothing is sent without consent.

params.label: Product identifier for ecommerce events
params.description: Which identifier to report for products across all ecommerce events (product view, cart, purchase), for consistent Matomo product reports.

params.label: Shorten tracked URLs
params.description: Replaces the Shopgate PWA build/CDN path prefix (shop id, theme, version, build hash, index.html) with '/...', keeping the origin and the app route. Example: https://…shopgate.com/shop_1/@shopgate/theme-ios11/7.31.1/1512359/index.html/category/abc → https://…shopgate.com/.../category/abc

params.label: Tracked site base URL (rewrite domain)
params.description: If set, the origin of every tracked url/urlref is rewritten to this domain (path kept). Needed when the Matomo site has 'only track visits when the URL starts with…' enabled, because the app's real url is the Shopgate CDN host (…shopgate.com), not the shop domain — so hits would be silently discarded. Set to the site's domain, e.g. https://www.example.com.
